Transaction.title: Transaction
Transaction.description: A financial ledger transaction representing income or expense.

datetime.description: The date and time of the transaction.

amount.description: The transaction amount. Positive for income, negative for expense.

type.description: Whether the transaction is an income or an expense.

category.description: Main category (e.g., 餐飲, 交通, 娛樂, 居家, 醫療, 數位服務, 其他).

subcategory.description: Subcategory (e.g., 早餐, 飲料, 大餐, etc.).

isRecurring.description: Whether this transaction was automatically generated.

recurringRuleId.description: Optional reference to the recurring template rule.

RecurringRule.title: RecurringRule
RecurringRule.description: A monthly template rule for automatic recurring transactions.

name.description: Name of the monthly subscription or recurring item.

type.description: Whether it represents income or expense.

dayOfMonth.description: Day of the month to trigger (1-31).

isActive.description: Whether the template rule is active.

lastTriggeredMonth.description: Year and month of last execution, e.g., '2026-05'.

/users/{userId}/recurringRules/{ruleId}.description: User templates for automatic monthly income/expenses.
